description: **DRIFT001 tells you how to resolve it.** Drift errors now end with a remediation hint naming `selfdoc baseline accept <page>`, so an operator whose description is genuinely still accurate has a stated way out instead of having to invent a description edit.

**`deploy_github_pages` requires an explicit target.** The function force-pushes a gh-pages branch and used to pick its destination from `git remote get-url origin` in the current working directory. It now takes a required `target` keyword: a remote URL is used verbatim, a directory path resolves that repository's own origin, and omitting it is an error.

**`topology.assembly` is rejected; `assembly.pages_project` is required for assemblies.** The config schema drops the `topology.assembly` key -- a config that still sets it now fails to load with an error naming `assembly.repo` as its replacement. `assembly` gains a required `pages_project` key, `topology` gains an optional `legacy_blog_host`, and `topology.posts_base` is documented as the canonical blog URL under the docs site rather than a separate host.

**`topology.legacy_blog_host` documents the right redirect target.** Its schema description said the generated assembly worker 301s the retired subdomain onto `posts_base`; the worker actually targets the canonical base derived from `topology.docs_base`. The description now says so.

**`ref` output now counts `__init__.py` re-exports and module-level constants.** The Python extractor emitted `###` headings only for classes and functions, so `__all__` re-exports (`from ._impl import X`) and module-level constants (`__version__`) were structurally uncountable in coverage even though they sit in the denominator. They now get headings, and `ref target=X` resolves a name that is only a re-export instead of erroring `not found`.

**Docstring-less public classes are no longer dropped from `ref` output.** A public class with no docstring, no methods, and no `@dataclass` decorator was silently omitted. Any class named in `__all__` now always renders at least a heading and signature, and pydantic `BaseModel` subclasses get the same field-table rendering as dataclasses.

**`selfdoc gen` no longer rewrites `.selfdoc/manifest.json` when nothing changed.** The manifest was rewritten on every run because its `last_gen` timestamp always differs, dirtying the working tree and breaking `--no-allow-dirty` release flows in a retry loop. It is now written only when its content (ignoring the timestamp) actually changes.

**`coverage_threshold` in `selfdoc.json`.** New optional float field (0.0-1.0, default 1.0) setting the minimum fraction of public symbols that must be documented for `selfdoc check` to pass. Lower it below 1.0 to accept partial coverage.
